english: Let $m$ and $n$ denote the order and the degree, respectively, of the differential equation of the family of curves
where $a_1,a_2,\dots,a_{10},b_1,b_2,\dots,b_{10}$ are arbitrary constants. Then the value of $m+n$ is ______.
hindi: जहाँ $a_1,a_2,\dots,a_{10},b_1,b_2,\dots,b_{10}$ स्वेच्छ अचर हैं, के अवकल समीकरण की कोटि तथा घात क्रमशः $m$ तथा $n$ हैं। तब $m+n$ का मान ______ है।
solution: $1,\cos2x,\dots,\cos20x$ are linearly independent, so there are $11$ essential constants (not $20$)
Eliminating $11$ constants gives an order-$11$ equation, linear in $y$ and its derivatives: $m=11$, $n=1$
solution_full: The $20$ constants enter only through the $11$ combinations $A_0,A_1,\dots,A_{10}$, and these can take any real values. The functions $1,\cos2x,\cos4x,\dots,\cos20x$ are linearly independent (for example, by orthogonality on $[0,\pi]$), so none of the $11$ constants can be absorbed into the others: the family has exactly $11$ essential constants.
The differential equation of a family with $11$ essential constants has order $11$, so $m=11$.

The family is a linear combination of fixed functions, so eliminating the constants (by the Wronskian of $y,1,\cos2x,\dots,\cos20x$) gives an equation linear in $y,y',\dots,y^{(11)}$. Its degree is $1$, so $n=1$.
Hence $m+n=12$. Counting all $20$ constants would give the wrong order $20$.
originality_note: New: a family with 20 visible constants whose span is only the 11 functions 1, cos 2x, ..., cos 20x, so the order of its equation is 11 (way 4, hidden reduction). Closest known: y = a sin^2 x + b cos^2 x + c cos 2x type essential-constant questions. Different because: the reduction happens in ten frequencies at once and the student must count independent functions.
blueprint_concepts: Order and degree of a differential equation
Formation of a differential equation by eliminating arbitrary constants

concept_use.Order and degree of a differential equat: The order equals the number of essential constants (11), and the equation is linear, so its degree is 1.
concept_use.Formation of a differential equation by: Forming the equation means eliminating the constants; first the 20 constants are reduced to 11 essential ones through sin^2 kx and cos^2 kx = (1 -/+ cos 2kx)/2.
